about: TP0 KV_SESSION_STATS counters of every worker of four guard runs (evict_stats outputs), for the eviction-pressure hold (E-hold) tests. t = seconds from the benchmark start (log clock PDT converted as in evict_stats). Sample = [t, evicted_c1_host_only, evicted_c1_dup, evicted_active_tokens], cumulative since the engine start; one engine generation per node. Built by build_evp_fixture.py.
